- Difficult to Use (complaint): High voltage battery : Not user-friendly / High voltage battery / Not user-friendly
- Defect (complaint): Seats : Malfunction / Seats / Malfunction
- Defect (complaint): Steering wheel : Malfunction / Steering wheel / Malfunction
- Defect (complaint): Vehicle, climatization : Malfunction / Vehicle, climatization / Malfunction
- unknown_feedback_type (unknown): no_class_found / no_class_found

Customer comment:

> i am happy with the new car. it is clearly more comfortable and in general more interesting than the older series i had. still, there are some drawbacks i really cannot ignore: - once the speed goes past about 110-120 km/h, the car is not well insulated anymore, wind noise becomes obvious and disturbing even though it has the special package. - at night, the driver's main rearview mirror gives a blurry picture, lights from cars behind and strong light sources look smeared, vertical lines show up and this makes driving harder. - the air conditioning will not run when the ignition is switched off. - there is no way to turn off the lights while the car is on (for example if you just want the ac working in a parking lot). - every single time you start driving you have to switch on the battery conservation function again. - the driver has no glove compartment now. before it was located to the left of the steering wheel. there is also no smaller extra glovebox like on the f01. - the driver's joystick/control stick feels very rigid when choosing left/right/up/down. - the driver's seat fails to go back to where it was before the car was shut down. - the cup holders do not offer cooling or heating at all.

Customer comment:

> this is probably my 7th or 8th 7 series. while the exterior styling is interesting, the comfort and ergonomics are not at the level of the earlier one. everything has to be operated through the center console, which i do not find safe while driving. the cost-cutting on this kind of vehicle feels ridiculous: the sunroof is gone without any prior notice, the little "pocket" on the left of the steering wheel is gone, the "comfort plus" setting has disappeared, and the seats are much less comfortable with fewer adjustments (for example, the headrest no longer properly supports anything). it is also very disappointing to see the v8 removed and to be forced into a hybrid petrol v6 that does not deliver driving pleasure, etc....

> spending around £128k on a car and then being asked to pay extra for a heated steering wheel is ridiculous. i've owned bmws for many years and this one will be my last. i lodged a complaint with bmw and they did not actually address it at all. to me it's simple: this is a bmw, not some brand that should be pushing paid "add ons" on a £128k car.
i even cancelled my order for the updated i7, which was about £146k. bmw eventually added the heated steering wheel to my current car for free, but that completely misses the point. if i wanted cheap junk with chargeable extras, i'd go to a cheap brand instead. meanwhile, mercedes s class includes a heated steering wheel at no extra cost, thank you very much.
so congratulations to whoever thought tacking on another £100 for that option was a smart move. right now i have 3 bmws in the household, and every one of them will be replaced by a mercedes.

Customer comment:

> the car itself has been a good one.
it is really frustrating that the headlights cant be switched off, and even when i turn on the air conditioner from my smartphone, the compressor doesnt run, so it just sends out air. the tires also wear out fast, and the size is so big that there are hardly any choices.
the staff member yamamoto at the coastal dealer where i bought it was one of the worst i have ever come across.
all communication was slow, i had a bad feeling already, and sure enough the response ended up being the worst i have ever experienced.
its one thing to mess up a car inspection, but you absolutely cannot make mistakes with the documents i prepared, since they are required for the procedure.
i asked them to redo the paperwork, yet there was no contact at all, and when i finally pushed, the document that was only valid for 3 months had already expired because of the negligence of the person in charge, so i had to go get the exact same document again. this should not happen with a car in the 10 million class.
i am furious with yamamoto.
since the place is far away, i almost feel it is a small blessing in misfortune that i dont have to depend on that dealer much.

- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Defect
- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Defect (complaint): Pedals, operate : Malfunction / Pedals, operate / Malfunction

Customer comment:

> Customer reported the check engine light came on and the vehicle then broke down. Customer took the car to the service center, where some parts had to be replaced. Writer asked for more information about the check engine light incident. Customer confirmed the service center addressed the concern and replaced the required parts. Customer stated he did not know exactly what the issue was, but the vehicle is running fine now.
Service Notes: Mileage: 1,164
Defect Code: 3541001500
Defect Description: Accelerator operation/accelerator pedal module permanent malfunction
Complaint: CUSTOMER STATES CHECK ENGINE LIGHT WENT ON VEHICLE WHEN STARTING HAVING ROUGH IDLE CHECK/ADVISE
Cause: Faulty accelerator pedal
Correction: Connected battery charger and performed vehicle test. Found faults relating to concern.(224181 and 224183). As per test plan, performed functional check of component. Accelerator position not detected. Checked harness for voltage. 5V found at power supply line to connector. As per test plan, internally faulty Accelerator pedal found. Removed and replaced accelerator pedal. Cleared faults. Test drove vehicle. No abnormal conditions at this time

### G70-0201

- Source: Source A
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: BEVE
- Feedback types: Defect, Difficult to Use, Likes, Wants, unknown_feedback_type
- Signal types: complaint, praise, unknown, unmet_need

Classifications:

- Difficult to Use (complaint): ConnectedDrive and Infotainment, overall technology : Not user-friendly / ConnectedDrive and Infotainment, overall technology / Not user-friendly
- Likes (praise): Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology : Like: function / Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology / Like: function
- Wants (unmet_need): Electric Range : Customer request: function / Electric Range / Customer request: function
- Defect (complaint): Intelligent Personal Assistant, activation word : Malfunction / Intelligent Personal Assistant, activation word / Malfunction
- Wants (unmet_need): My BMW App / MINI App : Customer request: function / My BMW App / MINI App / Customer request: function
- Wants (unmet_need): Navigation : Customer request: usability / Navigation / Customer request: usability
- Likes (praise): Route optimized for charging : Like: usability / Route optimized for charging / Like: usability
- Defect (complaint): Route optimized for charging : Malfunction / Route optimized for charging / Malfunction
- Difficult to Use (complaint): Route optimized for charging : Not user-friendly / Route optimized for charging / Not user-friendly
- Defect (complaint): Seats : Malfunction / Seats / Malfunction
- unknown_feedback_type (unknown): no_class_found / no_class_found

Customer comment:

> from a mechanical standpoint the car is excellent, in line with what i've come to expect from my previous seven bmws. it drives smooth, is very quiet and feels luxurious.
all of the problems i've run into are tied to the software.

route planning -
there is room to improve the in-car navigation system.
1-you are unable to plan a charging route starting from anywhere other than where the vehicle is currently parked, and you cannot set a starting charge level different from the present state of charge. that makes it impossible to pre-plan the second leg of a longer trip. this information should be something you can input.
2-the route suggestions are nowhere near optimized. for instance, i recently drove from fairview to bayport. the nav gave me a plan with charging stops showing an eleven and a half hour trip. having made that drive before (though not in an ev), i knew there was a more direct way. by simply dragging the route magnet through a different city, the recalculated route ended up about an hour shorter. why should i have to fix that manually?
3-the mybmw app ought to provide ev-specific route planning, similar to what my wife gets with her mercedes app for her ev.
4-route planning on bmwusa.com is basically useless. try it. choose range and route, i7 e50 20", put in a starting point like 210 harbor view rd, seaview beach fl and a destination like lakeside toyota of fairview. the result is just a line on the map with state names. no city labels. no identified charging stops. nothing that actually helps an ev driver. on a previous attempt it also showed a "?" button that, when pressed, only told me i would need to charge somewhere on the way. that is not helpful.
5-i ended up having to build a spreadsheet and use my own numbers to plan the journey. i've asked the local "genius" for guidance, but the way bmw's supporting software is designed is beyond what she can assist with.
6-i'm still hoping the mistakes are mine and that you can show me a better way to use these tools. but as i see things right now, the limitations of bmw's route planing tools aren't just unhelpful - they feel insulting. maybe that would be borderline acceptable in an economy car, but not in the i7.

seat positioning -
most of the time, after i unlock, get in, start the car and buckle up, the driver's seat moves correctly from the comfort access spot to the stored position 1 for driving. however, roughly 20% of the time it doesn't move at all. and once it even slid further back instead. usually tapping the "1" button will fix it, but sometimes that button has to be held down, and sometimes only the seat controls on the door will get it to move. i suspect there might be some link to how and when i clear the nuisance disclaimer message.

updates -
not long ago i was away for about a week. the first time i drove the car after coming back, i found a lot of things had been reset. my seat memories had vanished. the custom wake word i'd set was no longer active. saying "hey bmw" did nothing, even though those options still showed as selected in the menus. there were also new displays in the instrument cluster when driving with assist plus.
it would help if:
1 - existing user settings were kept intact when an update is installed.
2-a simple message popped up at startup letting the driver know the vehicle might behave differently than it did on the last drive.

thank you for looking at my comments on this car. it's unfortunate that these frustrations exist. out of all the bmws i've owned, this is the one i am most eager to drive.

i would really like to get a response to the issues i've mentioned.

mark ellis
[EMAIL]

Customer comment:

> honestly, getting this car was a mistake. the build quality is terrible for what it costs. i figured bmw's top end six figure model would give me a really high quality experience, but the main problem is the wind and cabin noise. on the freeway it sounds like the windows are a bit open or like driving straight through a wind storm, even when it's calm outside. the wind noise is insanely loud. i've ridden in other bmws and even cheaper cars and none of them had this level of wind sound. when other cars pass by you hear all of it, like there's missing insulation or something. the plastic glowing trim along the dash and doors feels super cheap too, it creaks and cracks over every bump, and the trim on the passenger door just rattles all the time. there are a few other little rattles and the vent controls are kind of awkward to use, but those are small compared to the wind noise. i bought this thing for a quiet, ultra luxury experience and it's the total opposite. i've been in lots of cars, even budget hondas and similar, and never had wind noise like this. my last car, a 2019 m550, was totally vault quiet at speed, so i dont know what happned here. very disappointing, i'm absolutely never going to buy or recommend a bmw again.

Customer comment:

> this car will not suit everyone. the ride is smooth and quiet, the seats and audio are excellent, and the fuel economy and performance are impressive for such a large vehicle. the accent lighting is something I truly enjoy. the downside is the slightly isolated feel of the ride and some tech that comes across as intrusive. the accelerator pedal has a bit of a sticky feel, and the wave-your-foot trunk opener hardly ever works. the nav system is dreadful. it does not seem set up for americans, and its guidance is often inconsistent and wrong: saying "bear left" when there is no reason, then not saying it when there should be; sending me onto blocked or unfinished roads even though the map later shows them as blocked; telling me to stay on the same road ahead when nothing is actually changing; using bear left/right when you are really turning onto a different road and it should say "turn left onto...". it also does not announce when it is rerouting. there is better technology out there.

Customer comment:

> Customer stated that she hears a loud banging noise coming from the rear of the vehicle when she walks up to it from the passenger side. Customer stated it sounds like metal pieces being tossed around. Customer stated this has occurred around 4 times since she has had the car. Customer stated the sound never happens while she is driving, only when she is approaching the car for the first time that day. Customer stated that, in a separate incident at a gas station, the fuel nozzle would not click off when she was filling the tank, causing the tank to overflow. Customer stated she brought the car to the dealership, and it took about two days for them to obtain a part and work on the gas tank. Customer stated she is no longer having any problem with the gas tank now. Customer stated that after the repair the banging noise became less loud but is still present. Customer stated the banging occurred twice before the repair and twice after. Customer stated the dealership could not duplicate the noise. Customer stated the sound happens randomly. Customer has approximately 863 miles on the vehicle at the time of the service. Customer stated she thinks the vehicle cannot be fixed and would like to see if she can trade it for something that does not give her anxiety.Defect Code:1611019400Defect Description:Filler pipe (including filler hose), fuel tank difficult to fill tankComplaint:client states when filing up gas at different stations, the gas keeps clicking off.Cause:client states when filing up gas at different stations, the gas keeps clicking offCorrection:Verified customer concern, with customer approval got gas slip to pump gas and pump kept clicking off very frequently. Brought vehicle into service, connected battery charger and ran faults. Found no faults related to concern. Removed fuel filler cap and found fuel filler flap not connected right. Removed and replaced faulty fuel filler pipe. Took vehicle to pump gas after repair pump now operates as designed no issue found pumping gas

### G70-0398

- Source: Source B
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Defect
- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Defect (complaint): Drivetrain : Malfunction / Drivetrain / Malfunction

Customer comment:

> Customer stated his car has been sitting in the dealer's service department since around 1/8, and it has basically been out of his hands this whole time. Customer stated the dealer, while running remote diagnostic checks, picked up an issue with the air and fuel mixture. Customer stated the store still does not have a clear answer on what is actually causing that air/fuel mixture problem. Customer stated he only noticed the check engine light turning on, and besides that he did not feel anything odd in the way the vehicle was driving. Customer stated the car had about 560 miles on it when he dropped it at the dealership, and now, while it is in their possession, the odometer shows roughly 902 miles. Customer stated he has no idea when he is going to get the vehicle back from the dealer.

Update from roughly 2/5/25:
Customer stated his overall experience with this vehicle so far has been poor. Customer stated the car has been tied up in service for around 24 days. Customer stated that when the vehicle only had about 100 miles, the Check Engine Light came on for the first time. Customer stated his service technician believed the concern was related to the O2 sensors. Customer stated that when the dealership contacted BMW engineering for support, engineering did not want to approve replacing those sensors at that stage and instead told service to clear the fault codes and have the customer drive the car more to see if the Check Engine Light would return. Customer stated the light did in fact come back on, and he then had to bring the vehicle back into the service department. Customer stated he ended up driving about 800 extra miles with the Check Engine Light illuminated. Customer stated that eventually service replaced the O2 sensors to resolve the issue. Customer stated they were also told the vehicle might require a software update if the Check Engine Light comes back again. Customer stated the way BMW handled the troubleshooting has been very frustrating and that BMW needs to listen more closely to what the technician on the ground is recommending. Customer stated that the second trip into service could have been avoided if BMW had listened to the technician who was diagnosing the car the first time. Writer asked how the vehicle has behaved since he picked it up after the repair. Customer stated he has had the car back for about a week and it is running OK, but he is still worried the check engine light might reappear.
Service Notes:
Mileage: 1,254
Defect Code: 1178031500
Defect Description:
Oxygen monitor sensor permanent malfunction
Complaint:
CLIENT STATES "CHECK ENGINE"/ "SERVICE ENGINE SOON" / "MIL" WARNING LIGHT IS ON.
Cause:
.PERFORMED VEHICLE TEST. ATTACHED BATTERY CHARGER. FOUND FC 034ABA HAD RETURNED. REOPENED TSARA [CASE_NO].
Correction: 
TSARA ADVISED TO REPLACE THE FAULTY OXYGEN SENSOR. REPLACED BANK 1 POST CAT O2 SENSOR. CLEARED ADAPTATIONS AND FAULTS. TEST DROVE VEHICLE. FAULT HAS NOT RETURNED, OK AFTER REPAIR.

### G70-0489

- Source: Source B
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Difficult to Use
- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Difficult to Use (complaint): Comfort Access : Not user-friendly / Comfort Access / Not user-friendly

Customer comment:

> Customer stated that because she has only one Key Fob, when she hands that Key Fob to a valet, they will leave it inside the vehicle, and then the doors end up locking the Key Fob in the car when she walks away carrying her Digital Key. Writer stated that to stop the Digital Key from locking the doors in this situation, she can turn off "Passive Entry" in Apple Wallet by tapping the BMW Digital Key, then tapping the lowercase "i" in the top-right of the phone screen, and toggling off "Passive Entry". Writer stated this keeps the Digital Key on her phone, and "Passive Entry" can be easily switched back on after she picks up the car from the valet. Writer stated another option is to activate the Service Card by placing it on the smartphone tray and following the activation prompt on the Control Display, then giving the valet the Service Card to use as the key for the vehicle.

### G70-0553

- Source: Source B
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Defect
- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Defect (complaint): Remote Engine Start (Vehicle Key ) : Connection fault / Remote Engine Start (Vehicle Key ) / Connection fault

Customer comment:

> Customer stated that during the second week of owning the vehicle he repeatedly received a warning saying the remote start could not be used. Customer stated that on the first visit to the dealer they were unable to locate the cause. Customer stated that on the second visit the dealer reached out to BMW engineers in Germany for help. Customer stated that shortly after he bought the car, BMW released a software update that resolved the problem. Customer stated the dealership installed this update and he had no further issues after getting the vehicle back from service. Customer stated he did not know the mileage when the problem first appeared.

Customer later called back to report the same issue had come back again. Customer stated he intends to return the vehicle to service.

Service Notes from second service:

Mileage: 1,128
 
Defect Code: 1032003500
 
Defect Description: Neutral quality when engine is warm Rough running
 
Complaint: CUSTOMER STATES THAT THE REMOTE ENGINE START CAN NOT BE PERFORMED AND THE CHECK ENGINE LIGHT IS ON
 
Cause: PROGRAM/ENCODED

Correction: D1 CONNETCED BATTERY CHARGER AND SHORT TESTED VEHICLE. FOUND FAULTS IN VEHICLE. NO TEST PLANS AVAILABLE. AS PER ACTION IN SERVICE VERIFIED I LEVEL BELOW RECOMMENDED LEVEL R5 PROGRAMMED VEHICLE. R8.

Service Notes from first service:

Mileage: 434

Defect Code: 1031003500
 
Defect Description: Neutral quality when engine is cold Rough running
 
Complaint: CUSTOMER STATES THAT THE CHECK ENIGNE LIGHT IS ON REMOTE ENGINE START IS NOT WORKING
 
Cause: CLEARED FAULTS

Correction: D1 CONNECTED BATTERY CHARGER AND SHORT TESTED VEHICLE. FOUND FAULTS FOR EME48. D5 PERFORMED VARIOUS TEST PLANS. TEST PLANS INDICATE NO FAULTS OR TESTING PROCEDURES. CLEARED FAULTS. R8

Customer comment:

> Customer stated he was worried about the vehicle being a Mild Hybrid. Customer stated he had an electric vehicle before that caused a lot of motion sickness. Customer asked how often the electric motor would be on and what speeds it comes on. Writer advised the electric motor assists the combustion engine, during the time the combustion engine shuts off when slowing toward a traffic light or stop sign. Writer advised it may typically come on under about 7 MPH. Writer advised it is usually not noticeable when the electric motor is operating. Writer advised the vehicle will begin to accelerate with the electric motor and then the combustion engine takes over. Customer asked if, when the vehicle is stopped in traffic for a while, the engine will turn back on to recharge the battery. Writer advised that it will, and also that the engine comes on when the climate control needs to heat or cool the cabin again.

- Feedback types: Defect
- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Defect (complaint): Driver profile : Malfunction / Driver profile / Malfunction

Customer comment:

> Customer stated he is trying to set up his personal profile so that when he gets in the car, the AC temperature and all other settings return to where they were left. Customer mentioned the profile appears on the screen with a welcome message and his name, but the settings are not restored to his previous values. Customer explained that his preferences are not being saved, including the AC and the seat position, and that he has to press seat memory button one again for the seat to go back where it should be. Writer asked if there is another driver involved and whether the customer is using a smartphone or Apple Watch as the key. Customer confirmed he uses a smartphone and is the primary driver about 99 percent of the time. Customer stated his wife does not have a profile set up on the 7 series. Customer stated he plans to visit the dealership when he has time to get assistance with the profile setup. Writer advised the customer to set all settings again, including the seat, make sure they are stored in the profile, and then lock the car upon exiting. Writer verified in Dealer cockpit that the permissions are configured correctly. Writer then asked if the customer also has an Apple Watch or carries the digital key card. Customer confirmed he only has an Apple phone and does not use an Apple Watch. Writer explained that once everything is configured and the vehicle is locked, the system should recognize the profile each time. Writer recommended going to the dealership if the issue continues. Writer also suggested performing an iDrive reboot by moving the car out of the garage, leaving the engine running, and pressing and holding the radio volume button for 70 seconds. Writer explained the screen may turn black as many as three times during that period and instructed the customer to keep holding the button for the full 70 seconds, then allow it to boot up to see if the settings are saved. Writer stated this procedure forces the system to update to the latest version since sometimes it is searching for settings that no longer exist. Customer confirmed he understood all the steps and stated he would try the reboot. Customer then stated he could not stay on the call. Customer stated he would contact the dealership later today or tomorrow to arrange an appointment for next week to address the profile settings concern.

Customer comment:

> the auto time zone adjustment just does not function. the radio also fails to quiet when i give carplay voice commands. with a 291 mile range, the actual distance i can use is heavily cut because i only charge between 20% and 80%. right now the public charging network feels both unreliable and not sufficiently available. every leg of a trip easily ends up with an extra hour added for each charging stop. i still dont know for sure, but if the battery life really proves to be just 8 years then this purchase will have been a poor investment. my insurance premium has shot up by about 200% even though the car has all this safety equipment. the explanation given is that repairing that safety tech after a crash costs a lot more, and the insurers claim there is not enough data yet to justify lowering the rates. sun glare or heavy rain seem to mess with the cameras trying to read the surroundings, and then the system basically chooses to shut itself off because it sees too much risk. when i drive on a road running parallel to train tracks, and a side street that crosses those tracks comes up, the railroad crossing lights aimed at the train get misread by the car as a stop light intended for my parallel road. there is also one set of traffic signals that the car reads as if they were a yield sign. the navigation does not let me set a preference for electrify america chargers when the planned distance exceeds the current charge; it just picks the first charger it finds. for at least the first 3 years, that electrify america selection option really should be there.

### G70-0840

- Source: Source B
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: BEVE
- Feedback types: Defect
- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Defect (complaint): Personal eSIM : Malfunction / Personal eSIM / Malfunction

Customer comment:

> Customer stated that from the time he took delivery, roughly 70% of the times he starts the vehicle the eSIM icon in the iDrive menu bar shows that the Personal eSIM is not configured and not working. Customer stated that when this occurs he cannot stream anything to the Theater Screen in the rear. Customer stated that in these instances, the iDrive Tel > Mobile devices list has the Personal eSIM entry highlighted with the note "Setting up personal eSIM" beneath it, and it never progresses or finishes. Customer stated he has gone to the dealership Genius multiple times and that the Genius adjusts something in the myBMW app to get it working again. Customer stated the fix does not last and the eSIM soon goes back to not functioning. Customer stated that he has been able to connect the eSIM and stream to the Theater Screen on some occasions, but that most of the time it fails because the eSIM never fully completes setup and connection.

Writer checked AIR and confirmed vehicle integration level G070-23-03-553 is newer than the -540 level specified for AT&T Personal eSIM. Writer connected via RVG and verified the issue: the sim card symbol with an exclamation mark in the menu bar indicated an eSIM fault. Writer confirmed the customer's description that the Tel > Mobile devices screen shows Personal eSIM highlighted with "Setting up personal eSIM" that does not change. Writer confirmed the customer was signed into his BMW ID / driver profile. Customer verified in the myBMW app that the Personal eSIM was activated on AT&T and stated he has an unlimited plan for the eSIM. Writer verified the customer's iPhone 14 is on iOS 16.5.1 and that the myBMW app is current and operating correctly.

Writer guided the customer to iDrive Menu > Vehicle apps > System settings > Update apps and services. Customer selected Update apps and services, and iDrive reported the vehicle software is current. Writer then walked the customer through a 30-second iDrive reset. Writer had the customer use the myBMW app to deactivate the eSIM from the i7. Writer next directed the customer in iDrive to Menu > Apps > Personal Hotspot > Connect new device. When the QR code appeared on the Control Display, customer stated the dealership Genius had previously skipped this step and done something different in the myBMW app, though the customer could not remember the details. Writer instructed the customer to scan the QR code. Customer stated the QR code did not proceed to move his phone further through the setup flow.

Writer then advised the customer to re-activate the eSIM using the Personal eSIM section in the myBMW app. Customer entered his phone number but the process stopped, and the app indicated he needed to add service. Writer guided the customer to select the eSIM device in iDrive and choose Activate internet access. Customer followed this, and his phone was forwarded to the AT&T login page. Customer signed into his AT&T account and tried to re-activate the eSIM on the i7, then ended the RVG session. Customer reported that on the AT&T site he was being asked to add service and that he could not re-activate the eSIM this way.

Writer explained that the problem appeared to be related to the customer's AT&T account, since AT&T was requiring added service for eSIM activation. Writer recommended that the customer contact AT&T to confirm his account and eSIM plan are truly unlimited and compatible with the Personal eSIM. Customer insisted the fault was with BMW. Writer still advised the customer to perform a 70-second iDrive hard reset to restart the telematics unit, even though the symptoms pointed more toward an AT&T account issue than telematics. Writer also recommended the customer return to the dealership so the Genius could repeat the same method they had used before to start the eSIM without involving the QR code or AT&T portal. Writer encouraged the customer to ask the dealership service department to check for any possible hardware defects due to the repeated nature of the problem. Customer did not specify what he intended to do next. Writer advised that the customer could reach out again with further questions or updates, but that the immediate next steps lay with AT&T or the dealership. Customer acknowledged.

### G70-0924

- Source: Source A
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Defect, Difficult to Use, Wants, unknown_feedback_type
- Signal types: complaint, unknown, unmet_need

Classifications:

- Difficult to Use (complaint): Automatic engine start-stop function (MSA) : Not user-friendly / Automatic engine start-stop function (MSA) / Not user-friendly
- Difficult to Use (complaint): Braking : Not user-friendly / Braking / Not user-friendly
- Defect (complaint): Door, open / close : Malfunction / Door, open / close / Malfunction
- Defect (complaint): Exterior : Malfunction / Exterior / Malfunction
- Wants (unmet_need): Handling / Riding : Customer request: usability / Handling / Riding / Customer request: usability
- Defect (complaint): Handling / Riding : Malfunction / Handling / Riding / Malfunction
- Defect (complaint): Interior : Malfunction / Interior / Malfunction
- Wants (unmet_need): My Modes / driving experience : Customer request: function / My Modes / driving experience / Customer request: function
- Difficult to Use (complaint): My Modes / driving experience : Not user-friendly / My Modes / driving experience / Not user-friendly
- Wants (unmet_need): Remote Software Upgrade/RSU : Customer request: function / Remote Software Upgrade/RSU / Customer request: function
- Defect (complaint): Seats : Malfunction / Seats / Malfunction
- Difficult to Use (complaint): Steering : Response characteristics not OK / Steering / Response characteristics not OK
- Defect (complaint): Transmission : Malfunction / Transmission / Malfunction
- Difficult to Use (complaint): Transmission : Not user-friendly / Transmission / Not user-friendly
- Defect (complaint): Trunk lid, open / close : Noise / Trunk lid, open / close / Noise
- Defect (complaint): Upholstery / interior trim : Fitting fault / Upholstery / interior trim / Fitting fault
- unknown_feedback_type (unknown): no_class_found / no_class_found

Customer comment:

> it is an excellent car in terms of ride comfort, steering feel, braking and the basics, but there are several "features" that make using it somewhat unpleasant.

1) with the car in drive, the doors will still open if someone accidentally touches the door open button. this feels dangerous. that function really ought to be disabled whenever the vehicle is in gear. and honestly, why have power opening doors at all when simple manual door handles have worked perfectly for roughly the last century.

2) the interior manual door release handles are positioned in places that are very hard to reach.

3) the auto stop-start turns the engine off before the car is fully stopped. in stop-and-go traffic this is irritating and inconvenient because you lose engine braking as soon as the engine shuts down.

4) there is no way to defeat the auto stop-start in the normal drive mode. i know using sport mode avoids this, but i do not want to drive around in sport mode.

5) the engine automatically switches off when you put the transmission in park and open the driver door. this is a hassle when briefly stopping to let a passenger out and then continuing the trip.

6) the horn will blast loudly while the car is in park if the driver steps out with the key to open the trunk or similar. i really dislike being yelled at by the car.

7) the front passenger seat slides backward toward the rear passenger as they open their door to get out, which makes it harder for them to exit. comfort exit is turned off in the settings, yet this still happens.

8) the driver seat moves backward and then instantly forward again when the transmission is put in park and the seatbelt unlatched, even though comfort exit is disabled in the seat menu.

9) the sharp, perforated metal grilles over the door speakers have led to several passengers and drivers snagging and breaking fingernails while feeling around for the door panel buttons.

10) there is no way to close the trunk lid from inside the cabin.

i am assuming other drivers have raised the same complaints and that bmw can deal with at least some of them soon with a software update. of course, the locations of the door release handles and speaker grilles would need a physical redesign.
 michael doran
lead chauffeur
fairmont holdings
[PHONE]

Customer comment:

> Customer reported that when he bought this vehicle, the yellow check engine indicator was already illuminated in the instrument cluster. Customer stated that the check engine light went off for a short period and then came back on. Customer indicated he took the car to the dealer, where they fully discharged the high voltage battery by driving the vehicle and then recharged the high voltage battery to full. Customer stated that after this work, the check engine light disappeared. Customer now reports the yellow check engine light is active again and said he does not plan to return to the dealer because he believes the warning is most likely due to software.

Defect Code:
6127057900
Defect Description:
SME / BMU battery management electronics for high-voltage battery (hybrid / e-vehicle) Incorrect con
Complaint:
CUSTOMER STATES HE PURCHASED THE VEHICLE ON SATURDAY AND THE CHECK ENGINE LIGHT WAS ON DURING DELIVERY PLEASE ADVISE
Cause:
Software error in SME
Correction:
Performed vehicle test and charged vehicle battery, voltage stable at 13.6 volts. Fault codes 031947 AC charging, charging electronics 2, component protection: group fault, 030E0B power management: abort emergency recharge, 21F04B high voltage battery uni

### G70-1060

- Source: Source B
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Difficult to Use
- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Difficult to Use (complaint): Braking : Noise / Braking / Noise

Customer comment:

> Customer stated that from the very first day of ownership, the brakes have sounded noisy. Customer stated the brakes sound wet and crunchy, almost like the pads are slipping on the brake rotors. Customer stated he particularly hears this brake noise when slowing to a complete stop, and also when his foot is on the brake pedal while turning the steering wheel. Customer stated he does not hear any squeaking or squealing from the brakes. Customer stated that when the vehicle is at a full stop and he lets off the brake pedal, it takes around 3 seconds before the car starts to creep forward. Customer stated that right before the vehicle begins creeping, it sounds as if one of the brake pads lets go from the rotor like it was stuck. Customer stated he previously took the vehicle to Metro BMW, but they did not inspect the brakes and simply dismissed the issue as normal. Customer stated he does not accept this noise as normal and has scheduled a service visit with Premier BMW on 8/15. Writer scheduled a follow-up call for 8/16.

Defect Code: 6130431500 
Defect Description: Shift paddle, steering wheel Permanent malfunction

### G70-1204

- Source: Source A
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: PHEV
- Feedback types: Difficult to Use, Wants, unknown_feedback_type
- Signal types: complaint, unknown, unmet_need

Classifications:

- Difficult to Use (complaint): Drivetrain : Response characteristics: too sluggish / Drivetrain / Response characteristics: too sluggish
- Wants (unmet_need): Interior design : Customer request: design / Interior design / Customer request: design
- Difficult to Use (complaint): Navigation : Not user-friendly / Navigation / Not user-friendly
- Wants (unmet_need): Seats : Customer request: function / Seats / Customer request: function
- Difficult to Use (complaint): Seats : Not comfortable / Seats / Not comfortable
- Difficult to Use (complaint): Speed Limit Assistant : Not user-friendly / Speed Limit Assistant / Not user-friendly
- Wants (unmet_need): Wheels / tires : Customer request: design / Wheels / tires / Customer request: design
- unknown_feedback_type (unknown): no_class_found / no_class_found

Customer comment:

> the car itself is quite nice, but there are a few areas that need improvement:

1-interior:
a-warm air isn't really warm enough and takes too long to build up. i have to put the temperature on max just to feel actual warmth.
b-the seats have plenty of adjustment options, but overall they are not very comfortable. maybe that's partly personal, but there should still be a default seat comfort you can expect at this level.
c-a rear-seat display should be standard at this price, not an extra-cost upgrade, especially nowadays when an oled screen is around 200$ for a consumer. if the motorization around it makes it pricey, that part should be the added cost.
d-the glossy trim shows fingerprints far too easily, and since everything is touch sensitive it's difficult to wipe it clean without accidentally changing settings.

2-driving experience:
a-for a car of this size, the steering feels a bit too wide. rear wheel steering seems like something that should be default for a premium vehicle like this.
b-overall the car is too needy, constantly popping up notifications, which can be distracting. the red light warning is not well tuned, as it will alert me even on the highway when it spots the signal for the entrance lane on the right. that is very distracting and frankly a bug.
c-switching out of autopilot isn't smooth enough, and the car behaves a bit stubborn. sometimes it decides to change lane at a very bad moment. for instance, if the navigation says i need to take an exit in under a mile, it shouldn't try to move into the opposite lane just to go faster.
d-the autopilot braking is quite harsh. even when it clearly detects the car ahead slowing, it reduces speed too late, making the brakes feel very strong.
e-when reactivating autopilot on streets with a speed limit, it should honor the current street limit, not only the setting. if i mistakenly turn the tempomat back on in a 25 zone, the car shouldn't start heading for 65.

Classifications:

- Defect (complaint): Vehicle battery : Warning / notification active / Vehicle battery / Warning / notification active

Customer comment:

> Customer reported the vehicle showed a low voltage battery malfunction notification that came up two times and then disappeared on its own. Customer explained the alert stated the starter battery was severely discharged and that certain power-heavy features, including remote services, were shut off to protect the battery. Customer added that the same warning appeared as a push notification on her phone at 3:55 PM on the 22nd of last month. Customer noted the car had fewer than 1,000 miles when this occurred. Customer shared that the easy entry seat position stopped functioning while the warning was present, then began working again once the message cleared. Customer stated she had no issues starting the vehicle after receiving the phone alert, and that the vehicle is currently operating normally. Customer indicated no service appointment has been set up because the warning has not returned, but if it does show up again she will arrange a visit with the dealer. Writer offered at no cost to send an over-the-air diagnostic email ahead of any possible dealer appointment and advised it would be sent to the email connected to the vehicle. Writer confirmed Bayside BMW Harborview as the chosen service facility. Writer informed the customer that the remote diagnostic is for the dealer and for our records.

### G70-1270

- Source: Source B
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Defect
- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Defect (complaint): Audio mode, sound : Malfunction / Audio mode, sound / Malfunction

Customer comment:

> Customer stated the audio in the car keeps glitching. Customer stated it happens when he is using Bluetooth to play downloaded songs from his phone, or when he uses a USB jump drive with music. Customer stated that after driving for a few minutes the sound starts acting up, the music cuts out, and there is a beeping noise like some kind of interference, as if something is trying to break in. Customer stated that FM radio and Sirius XM both work fine without any issues.
Customer stated this only occurs with the USB jump drive or downloaded music on his phone. Customer stated he left the vehicle at the dealership a few days ago, but the dealership was not able to duplicate the problem at first. Customer stated that on the way home from the dealership the glitch started again. Customer stated he brought the car back, and this time the technician confirmed the problem. Customer stated the dealership tried deleting his phone from the system and pairing it again, but that did not resolve it. Writer confirmed the phone is an iPhone 14 PRO, with carrier AT&T and iOS 16.3 installed.
Customer stated he does not use CarPlay.
Follow up: Customer stated the dealership still has his vehicle. Customer stated that even after confirming the malfunction, the dealership has not been able to diagnose it. Customer stated the dealership recorded a video of the issue and forwarded it to BMWNA. Customer stated he then received a text from the dealership saying BMWNA instructed them to reset the master system, and that they would now monitor the car. Customer stated he has been without his vehicle for about 2 weeks and is hoping to get an update from the dealership in the next day or so.
DCS: Defect Description: Bluetooth Audio (Combo) occasional failure

- Likes (praise): Interior comfort : Likes comfort / Interior comfort / Likes comfort
- Defect (complaint): Panorama glass roof : Damage / Panorama glass roof / Damage
- Defect (complaint): Upholstery / interior trim : Damage / Upholstery / interior trim / Damage
- unknown_feedback_type (unknown): no_class_found / no_class_found

Customer comment:

> my i7 has been an absolutely fantastic car so far, and the way it drives has felt perfect to me. it is extremely comfortable, and the overall quietness of the drivetrain and cabin is beyond what i have experienced with similar cars i owned before. the tech and amenities in the i7 meet or even surpass what i expect in this class. everyone who has ridden with me has been impressed with these same things. the range does drop in the winter, but for my daily use i find the range acceptable.

my only real issue with this particular car is that it arrived with bubbles in the sunroof glass, and the dealer is currently working on it. the car has been diagnosed with a manufacturer defect in the sunroof, with several small bubbles trapped between the glass layers of the panel. i am worried these imperfections could weaken the sunroof and affect safety over time, especially with temperature changes or impacts from rough or uneven roads. the team at bmw of Fairview has been great throughout all of this, showing professionalism, being transparent, and keeping me thoroughly informed while they resolve it. the problem, however, means the car needs a major teardown and repair, including removing the interior headliner, the pillar trim, the sun shade cassette, the windshield, and the driver assistance camera assembly, etc. since i have only had the car a few months, it is extremely frustrating to deal with such a big problem so early in ownership. i have barely had time to really enjoy what was supposed to be a flagship, brand-new vehicle before finding out it has to be significantly dismantled to fix this. as a long-time bmw fan and repeat owner, i have always respected the brand for its quality, precision, and innovation.

to date, the i7 has genuinely been a joy to own. in every other way it has met and even exceeded what i expect from a flagship executive sedan. the level of craftsmanship, the outstanding comfort, and the excellent noise isolation make each trip calm and very refined, which is exactly what i associate with bmw and the idea of the "ultimate driving machine." that makes this problem even more disheartening, since i expected years of worry-free enjoyment and trust in the car. with such a quiet cabin and electric drivetrain, i now fear that an invasive repair like this might never bring the car fully back to its original, factory-perfect state, and could introduce new shakes or rattles later.

- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Difficult to Use (complaint): Personal eSIM : Not user-friendly / Personal eSIM / Not user-friendly

Customer comment:

> Customer stated their main complaint is that their mobile provider does not work with the BMW for hotspot. Writer asked which carrier they use. Customer stated Verizon. Writer asked if the account is personal or business. Customer stated it is personal. Writer asked if the plan is unlimited. Customer confirmed it is unlimited. Writer advised the vehicle should be eligible for a personal esim. Customer stated they have already visited 2 different Verizon stores and were told it is not. Customer stated their sales advisor also said the vehicle is not eligible. Writer apologized for the mixed messages. Writer asked if, during setup, they receive a notification from Verizon that it is not compatible. Customer confirmed. Writer advised customer to contact BMW assist to have a ticket opened to resolve the problem. Writer advised the vehicle is presently running 07-24 and needs the 11-24 software update. Writer advised the update is being pushed in batches and that they will get a notification once it is available, but if they prefer not to wait they can visit their servicing dealer to have it updated manually, as there is a known issue with activating a new esim on 07-24. Customer acknowledged.

### G70-1462

- Source: Source A
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: PHEV
- Feedback types: Defect, Difficult to Use, Wants, unknown_feedback_type
- Signal types: complaint, unknown, unmet_need

Classifications:

- Difficult to Use (complaint): Automatic doors : Not user-friendly / Automatic doors / Not user-friendly
- Wants (unmet_need): Blind spot monitoring : Customer request: function / Blind spot monitoring / Customer request: function
- Defect (complaint): Drivetrain : Noise / Drivetrain / Noise
- Difficult to Use (complaint): Impression of safety : Not user-friendly / Impression of safety / Not user-friendly
- Difficult to Use (complaint): Vehicle safety, overall technology : Not user-friendly / Vehicle safety, overall technology / Not user-friendly
- unknown_feedback_type (unknown): no_class_found / no_class_found

Customer comment:

> i have a 750e 2026, and this is my second 7 series model. from the very first day, the car has been making a repeating knocking sound from the right rear passenger side, very much like the automatic door lock noise (da-da). the dealership has been supportive, understanding, and professional while trying to track it down, and they have traced it to a valve that is supposed to push gas vapors toward the engine when a certain buildup level is reached.
this sound is distracting and extremely annoying to everyone in the car, and it happens while driving, when stopped, with a full tank, with a half tank, and so on. to me, that points to poor quality control on the manufacturer side, which is very disappointing. i highly doubt this is just a single isolated case and assume you have already heard about it. the 750e is marketed as your flagship, but with this issue it does not really feel like one, and i think it needs to be handled properly at the manufacturer level. i am also worried it could be a safety-related problem.
as a separate irritation, i would expect bmw to include safety features that even cheaper cars already have. specifically, there should be an optional audible alert for blind spot lane changes, in addition to the triangle symbol on the side mirrors. that triangle is hard to see, and a tone to warn that there is a vehicle in the lane would be very useful and much appreciated. make it an option that can be turned on or off, but at least offer it.
thank you for letting me share my disappointment; bmw management really should look into these matters. this is my third bmw, and i am starting to lose that pride in owning one. none of this is a criticism of my local dealership, they are always professional and supportive. honestly, without their effort to keep clients satisfied, i would most likely already be back in a mercedes. the dealer team truly acts like quintessential professionals and treats customers like family.
again, thanks for your time. you can reach out to me directly if you wish; coastal bmw - clearwater, fl has my contact information.
- david lane

0.4 FELT TAPE IF POSSIBLE

Customer comment:

> During an RVG appointment, customer asked how to turn on Automatic Parking for perpendicular spaces. Writer explained that when getting ready to look for a spot, customer should press the parking assistance key on the center console, the one marked with a P and three lines. Customer confirmed the button was located. Writer explained this switches iDrive into the Parking view, where the vehicle begins scanning for suitable spaces. Writer stated the iDrive display will show which spots are detected in the searching area of the screen, and customer will then pick the desired space and parking style. Writer advised that iDrive will then instruct the customer to release the brake pedal so the vehicle can start the self-parking maneuver. Writer added that once the automatic parking is finished, iDrive will show that the procedure has ended and will shift the vehicle into park. Customer acknowledged the explanation.

- Source: Source B

Customer comment:

> Customer stated she had dash problems in her previous X6 and chose the 7 Series thinking a more premium model would be free of such issues, but the same type of problem is happening. Customer stated the dash display went completely black around three times before she brought the car to the dealer about a month ago, where they performed a system enhancement/update (current i-level 25-07-551, i-level ex works 25-03-536, update pending for i-level 25-03-545) and advised this would resolve the concern. Customer stated the screen still went black again about four days ago, so the vehicle is scheduled to go back to the dealer on Friday 10/24. Customer stated the screen has always come back on after each blackout, but she does not feel safe driving the vehicle, has mostly left it parked in the garage, and is nervous about taking it on trips out of town. Customer stated a $100,000 car should not be experiencing these kinds of problems and asked to be moved into another comparable vehicle that does not have them. DCS notes for the first visit: Claim Mileage: 3,709. Defect Code: 6512580200. Defect Description: Head Unit High HU-H (Nav Professional) Software error / internal device fault. Complaint: C/S THAT ONE SIDE OF THE IDRIVE SCREEN IS GOING BLACK. THIS DOES NOT HAPPEN ALL OF THE TIME. PLEASE ADVISE. Cause: HEADUNIT HIGH HUH SOFTWARE ERROR/INTERNAL DEVICE FAULT. Correction: VERIFIED CONCERN, FOUND CID FLICKERING ONCE. CONNECTED BATTERY CHARGER AND PERFORMED VEHICLE TEST, NO FAULTS FOUND RELATING TO CONCERN. PER SIB: 65 35 24, PROGRAMMED VEHICLE TO LATEST I-LEVEL DUE TO HEADUNIT SOFTWARE ERROR. TEST DROVE TO VERIFY REPAIR, OPERATING AS DESIGNED.

Defect Code:
 
5146052900
 
 
Defect Description:
 
Roller sunblind/sun curtain, door window glass, rear Jammed / stuck
 
 
Complaint:
 
SPECIAL ORDER PART ARRIVED: CUSTOMER REPORTS THE RIGHT REAR WINDOW SHADE BINDING ON INTERIOR DOOR FELT WHEN GOING UP. NOT GOING ALL THE WAY UP ALSO.
 
 
Cause:
 
RIGHT REAR ROLLER SUN BLIND FELT SEAL IS WARPED AND BINDING THE APPOSITE WAY. [PHONE] 2ND TIME
 
 
Correction:
 
CONNECTED BATTERY CHARGER VOLTAGE READING AT 13.5 VOLTS PERFORMED SHORT TEST, BUT NO RELEVANT FAULT CODES WERE FOUND. REMOVED PASSENGER REAR DOOR TRIM PANEL, FOUND ROLLER SUN BLIND FELT SEAL IS WARPED AND BINDING THE APPOSITE WAY. SOP PART NOT AVAILABLE

Customer comment:

> Customer stated the driver side door becomes warm near the armrest area when the seat heater is turned on and that the door panel cools down again when the seat heater is switched off. Customer explained they like the seat heater function but have never owned a car where the seat heater also heats the side of the driver door and believes this is a defect. Customer stated the dealer advised this condition is within specifications and considered normal. Writer asked if the customer might be describing the armrest heating technology, a feature on higher end BMWs where the door armrest and the center console armrest heat up independently when it is cold. Writer explained this armrest heating should operate separately from the seat heater and can be shut off in the iDrive system if the customer does not want it. Writer noted the vehicle uses temperature sensors and automatically turns on the armrest heating when it is very cold outside. Customer was not aware of the separate armrest and center console armrest heating feature and appreciated being informed about this functionality.

Customer comment:

> Customer stated that shortly after purchasing the vehicle, they had to bring it to the dealership due to a wind noise. Customer stated the dealership said they needed to order a new window sill for the window. Writer questioned. Customer stated his wife is the main driver of the car and provided the number for the primary driver. Primary driver stated that every time she drives, she hears a wind noise coming in through both the driver side and passenger side windows. Customer stated she attempts to raise the window, but still hears air coming through. Customer stated she hears it on a long rural road as well as on the highway. Customer stated she has not noticed the noise increasing in volume as speed goes up. Customer stated she first noticed it about 1 week after they got the car. Customer stated she does not feel air entering the cabin. Customer stated that when she drove with the windows down, she did not notice anything unusual. Customer stated that when she took the car in, they told her they needed to order a seal for the windows. Customer stated she has not received any update from the dealership and that it has been about 3 weeks. Writer transferred the customer to the dealership.

Claim Mileage: 2,594
Defect Description:
Play, USB, center console permanent failure

CUSTOMER STATES CHARGING PORT UNDER MIDDLE ARM REST DOES NOT OPERATE CHECK AND ADVISE

FAULTY USB HUB

### G70-1884

- Source: Source B
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Difficult to Use
- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Difficult to Use (complaint): Vehicle, climatization : Effect, power not OK / Vehicle, climatization / Effect, power not OK

Customer comment:

> Customer stated he is not pleased with how the Climate Control system behaves. Customer stated he originally relied on Auto mode, but reported that it keeps the fan running on a low setting the entire time. Customer stated that in all his prior cars he would simply put the temperature at 70 and the system would manage everything, whereas now he feels he has to go into Manual mode and crank the temperature all the way down to get the cabin to cool. Writer asked whether the fan might have been set to Level 1, but customer was unsure. RVG accepted. Customer then switched the car back to Auto mode and confirmed it was at Level 2 with the temperature set to 70 degrees while it was about 95 degrees outside. Customer stated that with the interior as hot as it is, he expects the climate to ramp up to full blast, but instead it stays gentle and he ends up sweating. Customer stated that for him to actually notice cooling, he must change to Manual mode and select Max AC. Customer stated he never had to rely on Max AC in his last vehicle, a Mercedes 560. Customer said he did not have additional time to talk and mentioned he would call again later to resume the discussion.

- Difficult to Use (complaint): Interior mirror, garage door opener : Not user-friendly / Interior mirror, garage door opener / Not user-friendly

Customer comment:

> Customer stated they followed the Owner's Manual to try and pair their gate, but the process did not work. Customer stated their previous 7 Series BMW had no issue pairing with the gate, but the system on this rearview mirror looks different and might not be compatible. 
Writer asked if, during pairing, customer was using the handheld remote or the button on the actual gate opener. 
Customer stated they were using the remote. 
Writer asked if the engine was running during the attempt. 
Customer confirmed the engine was on. 
Writer advised that putting in a fresh remote battery can help, since the system requires a strong signal to connect. 
Customer stated they are unable to do the second pairing method because it is a community gate and security will not allow it. 
Writer advised they could try again with the remote now. 
Writer advised to press buttons 1 and 3 until the indicator light changes frequency, explaining this clears any stored attempts. 
Writer advised then to hold the remote 1 to 3 inches from the rearview mirror, and press and hold the remote button together with the chosen mirror button until the light changes frequency. 
Customer stated the light turned green and began flashing. 
Writer asked if customer is able to test the gate with the mirror button. 
Customer stated the gate is currently more than 100 miles away and they will call back if needed.

Customer comment:

> Customer stated that about 4 days after buying the vehicle he was using the Back Up Assistant to back out of his garage. Customer stated that when he lifted his foot off the brake pedal, the vehicle suddenly picked up speed on its own. Customer stated the car then made contact with the side wall of the garage and the driver side mirror was damaged. 
Customer stated his hands were not on the steering wheel at the time. Customer stated he had tried the Backup Assistant earlier in a parking lot and the same kind of speeding up occurred there as well. Customer stated that in the parking lot he did not hit anything. Customer stated it felt like the car sped up to roughly twice the speed it should have been going and that it was moving around 10-15 MPH. 
Customer stated the dealer has ordered the necessary parts. Customer stated that 5 of the 7 parts have arrived so far and he is still waiting for the remaining parts. 
Customer stated he has never used cruise control, so it was not switched on. 
Writer activated RVG and captured photos and video of the mirror, the area, and the steps the customer followed.

Customer comment:

> this car was delivered on pirelli high-performance tires that made the ride far too harsh for a luxury sedan. i ended up paying myself to swap to oem-spec bridgestone turanza 6s, which transformed the comfort, and tire choice really should be sorted at the factory for customers who care about refinement.

the 48v mild-hybrid start/stop is still quite rough. compared to other isg/bsg systems from different brands, and to my 2024 530i with a belt starter generator, the restart from a standstill is abrupt and gives a noticeable jolt even when holding the brake, and it can feel coarse as the car comes to a stop. that takes away from the premium driving experience, especially when mercedes and range rover have virtually imperceptible stop/start.

on top of that, ota software updates arrive very late, which is disappointing versus other luxury makers. more timely updates would really help the overall ownership experience.

Customer comment:

> the car is just incredible in every respect and i really love it. i only want to highlight two things that, although clearly intended well, are flawed. first, the front passengers don't have truly adjustable ac vents. there's a tiny on knob under the vent panel to tweak the airflow a bit, but the range of adjustment is extremely limited. i understand the sleek look of a dash without the usual vents, but here it feels like form winning over function, and the ac function suffers a lot because of that choice. second, the driver's side open door button is a problem. i tend to lean my left leg against the driver door while i'm driving, and very often my knee hits that open button and the door pops open even as the car is moving. that's really frightening and unsafe. it doesn't do it when the door is locked and the speed is over roughly 10 mph, but it happens below that speed. those are the only two points i have that i think would make the car safer and better for the driver.

### G70-2120

- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Defect (complaint): Parking Assistant : Malfunction / Parking Assistant / Malfunction

Customer comment:

> Customer explained he had stored a path into his garage for the maneuver assistant so that he can get out of the car and complete the parking process from his iPhone. Customer stated that ever since saving this route, the vehicle will notify him when he reaches the activation point, but the alert will not stop once it has started. Customer stated the gong keeps sounding repeatedly until he has driven roughly 2 miles and is well past the activation point. Writer asked if this occurs every time and customer confirmed it does. Customer also stated there is no way to remove any recorded paths from the menu. Writer asked if he can see the stored paths in the parking assistant, and customer said yes, but when he selects one there is no option to delete it. Writer asked whether the camera view stays on while driving or if only the alert continues. Customer stated that the display switches off once he reaches a certain speed and returns to the main iDrive screen, but the gong alert keeps going. Customer stated he has already updated apps and services in the vehicle and performed an iDrive reboot, yet the problem remains. Customer stated he intends to drop the vehicle off with service at the end of this week. Writer arranged a follow up call. Customer stated the vehicle has about 210 miles on it. Writer called again to check on the repair status, but the customer did not answer. No DCS or AIR Notes.

> this is an excellent car and my 5th 740i. but the air conditioning is terrible. i live in south florida, and if the car sits in the sun, it's basically undriveable for about 5 - 10 minutes until it cools down some. there needs to be a direct vent blowing at the driver's face, and the controls get so hot they are hard to touch.

my car was supposed to come with regular tires but showed up with run flats. i had two flats in about two months and it cost me over $1,000. it shouldn't be like that; run flats are not good for florida with the heat and all the construction debris.

- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Difficult to Use (complaint): Personal eSIM : Not user-friendly / Personal eSIM / Not user-friendly

Customer comment:

> Customer reported that a couple of times when he got into the car, the eSIM was either not connected or had no service, so his FireTV on the Theater Screen could not connect. Customer noted that when the eSIM failed to connect, he was in an area with poor cell service. Customer stated his Driver Profile was already signed in and he was using a Digital Key at the time. Customer added that once he arrived back home, he tried the eSIM again and it connected normally, and he was then able to use the Theater Screen with FireTV without issue. Customer confirmed the eSIM is currently still working normally.
Writer explained that the eSIM may have been impacted by the weak cellular reception. Writer mentioned the eSIM uses the car's antenna, which should improve reception compared to a phone, but it is still limited by areas with poor signal. Writer suggested checking for Remote Software Upgrades and for updates to Apps & Services in iDrive by going to the Apps Menu, then System Settings, then Remote Software Upgrade to look for available upgrades. Writer then advised checking for updates to Apps & Services under the same System Settings section. Customer stated he plans to check for these updates soon.

### G70-2277

- Source: Source B
- Vehicle: G70

- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Difficult to Use
- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Difficult to Use (complaint): Drive Recorder : Not user-friendly / Drive Recorder / Not user-friendly

Customer comment:

> Customer stated he is unsure how to turn on and operate the recording function, even after viewing instructional videos that show the vehicle recording scenery in natural areas. Writer explained that the customer should press and hold the button with the P symbol, waves, and camera icon on the center console for about one and a half seconds to start a recording, and that he can choose which cameras to use, including the overhead camera and the front camera. Writer confirmed each recording is roughly 30 seconds long. Customer then asked how the automatic recording feature can tell that an impact is about to happen before a crash. Writer advised that the system relies on the front sensors, mirror-mounted sensors, and rear bumper sensors to track the closing speed between the customer's vehicle and other vehicles, and when that closing speed suggests a possible collision, the system starts recording 20 seconds before the impact and continues for 30 seconds afterward.

Customer comment:

> Customer stated the vehicle displayed a message indicating a back seat restraint malfunction. Customer stated she brought the vehicle to the dealer and believed the problem had been taken care of since the warning message disappeared. Customer stated that about a week later, the same message returned, so she brought the vehicle back to the dealer, and she is currently waiting to hear back from them.
DCS service notes: 37 miles.
Defect Description: Wiring harness, vehicle interior incorrect connection /contact 
Complaint: CUSTOMER STATES REAR PASSENGER RESTRAINT WARNING ON PLEASE CHECK 
Cause: FOUND OPEN CIRCUIT IN THE WIRING FOR THE DRIVERS REAR SEAT BELT BUCKLE.
Correction: CONNECTED CHARGER. CHECKED FAULTS. FOUND OPEN CIRCUIT FAULT STORED FOR LEFT REAR SEAT BELT BUCKLE. FOLLOWED TEST PLAN. CHECKED WIRING FROM BUCKLE TO ACSM. FOUND .3 OHMS. DRAG TESTED PINS IN ACSM AND BUCKLE. FOUND FINE. REMOVED FRONT AND REAR CARPETS, REAR
REAR SEAT BACK, AND DASH PANEL. WT-22 FRUS MADE NEW WIRING AND OVERLAYED ALONG ORIGINAL ROUTE. RE CHECKED.FOUND FAULT IS GONE.

DCS Notes from the first visit: Defect Code: 1142004800 Defect Description: Main flow, oil filter Not leaktight Cause: Faulty Full-Flow Oil Filter housing. 11 99 000 - WORKTIME FOR CLEANING OIL CONTAMINATED UNDER PANELS Correction: TSARA 3053430. Leak eliminated. Used 1 gallon coolant.

- unknown_feedback_type (unknown): no_class_found / no_class_found

Customer comment:

> right now there is basically no charging network in places that feel safe. the car itself was pretty loud and it came across like the build quality was worse than the m8 we owned before, with a lot of road noise, mainly on the driver side. the vehicle is gorgeous and rides nicely, but i really think bmw should include adapters so you can charge at brighter, well lit stations. most of the chargers we found were out in the middle of nowhere, and many of them were not on charge america, so the 30 minutes of free charging perk almost never got used. i really liked the exterior styling and the interior design. i ended up giving it a rating of 3 because it seems fine for driving around town, but feels unsafe for long trips. my wife was nearly stuck in the middle of oklahoma because the charging station was closed and located inside a dealership. she had to sit charging for hours in a rough part of town, in an area with bad lighting. on top of all that, the safety system in the car and the steering assist stopped working early in the journey. overall, i honestly would not suggest buying an electric car right now, at least until bmw sorts out being able to charge safely while traveling.

### G70-2581

- Source: Source A
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Difficult to Use, unknown_feedback_type
- Signal types: complaint, unknown

Classifications:

- Difficult to Use (complaint): Steering : Response characteristics not OK / Steering / Response characteristics not OK
- unknown_feedback_type (unknown): no_class_found / no_class_found

Customer comment:

> i am both a bmw fan and a driving enthusiast. over roughly the last 50 years i have been lucky enough to own a variety of mercedes and bmw vehicles, including several s classes and several 7 series. i had a '22 760i that i really loved, and i originally ordered it with the autobahn package. bmw ended up deleting that package, but i still accepted delivery of the car. i already knew how good ars is because i had an '05 750i where ars was standard equipment, and that remains one of the best driving and riding cars i have ever owned. once bmw brought the autobahn package back, i felt i had to get it, and i have absolutely no regrets. the change in ride, handling, and steering response is very clear and noticeable, and this is honestly one of the best cars i have had. i just came back from a trip of a bit over 2000 miles and the car performed flawlessly. the way it combines ride comfort with handling is remarkable, with the suspension staying composed over all the different surfaces on i-95. i have taken that same drive many times in my other cars, and this one is the best "road" car so far. my only real comment is that i wish bmw would push acoustic control further. even though the car is already very quiet, i think adding true acoustic glass with an acoustic interlayer and proper labeling, together with active noise cancellation, could provide an extra 2-4db of noise reduction. i do not quite see why this has not been done yet, especially considering the rolls royce experience. maybe these features could be bundled into an "acoustic package". i am looking forward to the lci version expected in 2027. thank you, and please keep making great cars!

Customer comment:

> performance, reliability, tech, luxury, comfort - the whole package is there. i'd really like to be able to pin more apps onto that left sidebar on the home screen. i used to have the weather sitting there, then it just seemed to vanish. i rely on quick shortcuts, so i ended up putting the weather app in the shortcut section instead.
about a week after i bought the car i got a flat tire, right after a storm, and bmw connect happened to be down. i had to arrange one tow to get back home, then a second tow to reach the bmw dealer that's out of town. that meant a lot of time just waiting around for tow trucks. in that situation a spare tire would have been very useful. i was told i'd be reimbursed for the towing because bmw couldn't provide a tow, but that was in october and i still haven't received anything.
otherwise the car itself is fantastic. i really like being behind the wheel. i've always enjoyed driving, and with this being my 4th bmw - a 528 and two 740s before - this 760 tops them all. it has taken the driving experience to a completely new level for me.

- Market: US
- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Difficult to Use
- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Difficult to Use (complaint): Operate selector lever : Not user-friendly / Operate selector lever / Not user-friendly

Customer comment:

> Customer stated this is his first BMW, and he is used to pushing the gear lever forward in his other cars to select Park and then getting out. Customer stated that in this vehicle, pushing the gear selector forward actually puts it into Reverse. Customer stated that if he then lets go of the brake pedal, the car begins to reverse. Writer stated this is something he should be aware of. Writer stated it may be helpful to turn on a feature that automatically activates the Parking Brake when the car is switched off. Writer stated to go into the Apps Menu, then choose Driving settings, Drivetrain and chassis, Parking brake, and switch on the option that engages the parking brake when the drive-ready state is turned off. Writer stated it is also a good habit to press the Parking Brake button after stopping the car. Writer stated that once this setting is on, either pressing the Engine Stop button or the Parking Brake button will place the car in Park and apply the Parking Brake.

### G70-2694

- Source: Source B
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Defect
- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Defect (complaint): Fuel filler flap , open / close : Malfunction / Fuel filler flap , open / close / Malfunction

Customer comment:

> Customer stated they are extremely disappointed with the dealership, explaining they have already been back three times because the gas door does not work. Customer stated that when they first bought the vehicle, they were not allowed to leave with it because the gas door needed to be fixed. Customer then returned to pick up the vehicle and it had a full tank of fuel, but when they went to fill up again the gas door would not open. Customer stated the dealership towed the vehicle from them, kept it for about a week and a half, then towed it back to them in a dirty condition and with only 12 miles of range left. Customer then noticed the gas door was the wrong color, completely black instead of their carbon black. Customer stated they are still waiting for this to be corrected, as they are currently out of town but plan to bring the vehicle back so the color issue can be addressed.
Defect Code:
4163004100
Defect Description:
Fuel filler flap (including cover housing) Poorly adjusted
Complaint:
Cause:
looked up part and there are non in the country . removed inner wheel well liner and had to release fuel lid door tabs from the back side . was able to get the tabs to release . removed fuel lid door housing assembly. got stock # pcn21257 .
Correction:
removed the fuel lid housing assembly and installed in this vehicle . did this because car is sold and customer waiting . we had to find a new fuel lid housing from another dealer that had it in inventory and purchase it from them.
Technician Notes:
got new fuel lid door assembly from dealer and installed in stk# pcn21257 that I took it out of .
Defect Code:
4163004100
Defect Description:
Fuel filler flap (including cover housing) Poorly adjusted
Complaint:
C/S THAT GAS DOOR WONT OPEN, PLEASE CHECK AND ADVISE.
Cause:
Correction:
fuel pot is bad . had to break into to get fuel lid open. fuel door tabs broke. replaced fuel pot assembly and fuel lid door cover.

Customer comment:

> the performance jump in electric mode is spectacular, apparently from having a second gear there. the bigger battery gives a huge mileage gain: our previous 740e and 745e averaged about 51 mpg over their lives with driving around northern virginia, while the 750e is running over 141 mpg under the same conditions. all three have had the individual interior, which still looks stunning, though I miss the little mini glove box on the left side. the seats are more comfortable than in the 740e and 745e, and the trunk space is clearly larger, which I really appreciate. we get more regular "like your car" remarks from strangers now, with the standard 19" wheels and brooklyn grey with xpel stealth, though I wish frozen bluestone had been an option. I like the automatic doors, even if they are a touch quirky. the voice assistant is better now and really helps make up for the lack of buttons. the interior lighting is excellent, and the ride and handling are outstanding. the child proofing is smartly done; the rear seat car seat flap is the best approach I have seen, and the voice assistant blocks window operation.
