Customer comment:

> Customer stated he would rather have the old way of getting wi-fi in the car instead of having to deal with esim setup. Customer stated the esim setup process was an absolute nightmare and that he put in more than around 20 hours trying to sort it out. Customer stated BMW and the carrier should have some kind of stop gap, because if a customer already has a device on their line using esim you cannot have another one. Customer stated that every time he started the vehicle, it triggered a request to his provider to authorize esim, and their system would run a credit check, approve the esim and add an extra line, then charge him. Customer stated that when he looked at his Verizon bill he noticed there were over roughly 24 esim lines on the account and he was being billed for each one. Customer stated he had to pay about a $1000 phone bill up front while working with his provider afterwards to remove all the extra lines and secure a refund. Customer stated that due to this situation he also found that his Apple Watch and his daughters Apple Watch no longer operate unless they are within range of their phones.

- Defect (complaint): Braking : Malfunction / Braking / Malfunction
- Defect (complaint): Center armrest, front : Malfunction / Center armrest, front / Malfunction

- Difficult to Use (complaint): Impression of safety : Not user-friendly / Impression of safety / Not user-friendly
- Wants (unmet_need): Panorama glass roof : Customer request: function / Panorama glass roof / Customer request: function
- Defect (complaint): Resting state after door opening : Malfunction / Resting state after door opening / Malfunction
- Wants (unmet_need): Seating, ventilate / heat : Customer request: function / Seating, ventilate / heat / Customer request: function
- Difficult to Use (complaint): Wheels / tires : Noise / Wheels / tires / Noise
- unknown_feedback_type (unknown): no_class_found / no_class_found

Customer comment:

> so far the car has been performing amazingly. it is very quiet, rides smooth, and is extremely comfortable. the auto drive / cruise control setup is good, but a bit confusing to switch between at first. i really wish there was clearer instruction and more direct control over the driving safety features. that stupid safety thing tries to brake constantly. and even when it needs to brake, why so hard and so early instead of more gradual? it makes me feel like i am driving badly and either irritating people by creeping toward stopped traffic or risking a wreak.

the touchscreens look great, but i would rather have more real buttons. it is awkward to tap the media "button" on the center console twice, you have to lift your finger fully and press again, which would be much simpler with a clicking button. all those controls could have been discrete buttons. there is no mute button on the steering wheel, which seems like a big oversight. and even when you do manage to hit the mute on the center armrest, it really just acts as pause - you can unmute but the player stays paused (at least on android with mediamonkey). i also don't get why the music doesn't actually pause when navigation gives directions; it just dips the volume like a radio, but a player could pause. my mercedes does both, with a steering wheel mute and pausing for instructions.

i also don't understand why the running lights stay on for hours; it seems tied to turning the car off then opening the door, or opening the door when the car goes to standby, but it's very confusing. the ac vents are useless if the car has been sitting in full sun, totally inadequate. i want finer control over a/c fan speed and vent routing - it's too easy for everything to get unsynced or for a small change to kick it out of auto mode. i wish the seat coolers were quieter. and i really wish there was an option without the glass roof, because that thing does nothing to block the sun and heat.

> Customer stated he continues to pay for an eSIM, but the Amazon Fire TV on the Theater Screen has stopped working. Customer stated the eSIM is activated, connected to his BMW ID, and has been added as a device in the vehicle under the Mobile Devices menu. Customer stated that when he turns on the Theater Screen and selects the Amazon Fire TV input, the screen displays a prompt advising him to verify that the internet connection is active and that roaming is enabled. Customer stated he has previously watched an entire football game using Amazon Fire TV on the Theater Screen.
Writer stated to go to the Apps Menu, then Vehicle Apps, and then Mobile Devices to confirm that "Personal eSIM" appears. Writer stated to open the Personal eSIM settings to make sure the data connection is permitted and roaming is switched on. Customer stated he was inside the vehicle and verified these settings are correct. Writer stated to recheck that the Theater Screen source is set to Amazon Fire TV and that the customer Amazon account is properly linked in the settings. Customer confirmed both of those settings are correct. Customer stated he did not have additional time to continue troubleshooting and that he will consult the dealer regarding this concern. The writer was not able to obtain more details about the service provider or whether the data plan is unlimited.

Customer comment:

> we absolutely love our i7. it rides so smoothly, looks really elegant, is packed with cool technology, and the real world range is quite good. we use it both for business and personal needs. we shuttle clients, mostly physicians at a clinic, and they are very impressed with the car and really like that it is an ev.

my spouse and i enjoy taking it everywhere. we have put close to 4800 miles on it in about 3 months, and it hardly feels like that much. it is a joy to drive on longer road trips.

there are a couple of things i would change. the subwoofer seems like it should be placed somewhere in the cabin. i think there is an upgraded diamond surround system that might add this. i owned a 2016 m5 before, and the bass in that car was just right. a friend has a 2024 ix, and i was amazed by the sound system in his.

ours is carbon black, so it gets washed often. one thing i noticed is that the rear trunk lid, especially the area under the rear bmw badge, traps a lot of water and it drains slowly. when it finally drains, it runs down onto the rear bumper and leaves water spots. we even use a blow dryer and it still causes some hassle. every car has its quirks, so i am not overly concerned.

also, i feel like the master window controls on the driver door should be moved back about 1-2 inches. even after 3 months, i still end up opening the rear windows when i mean to open the fronts. the placement feels unnatural. i'm 6 feet tall and have never really run into this in another vehicle.

overall, i really love this car and already look forward to owning another one someday. thanks for making such a gem of a vehicle.

Customer comment:

> while i actually prefer how the 7 series interior looks compared to the s class, i would still tell most family and friends to go with the s class instead, because of a mix of issues i've run into.

first, the premium audio: the top b&w setup is just so-so. for a "top of the line" system it doesn't stack up against the burmester premium system at all.

then the transmission behavior. when you really get on the throttle, the shifts in my 760i are noticeably rough. even my previous s63 amg, under heavy acceleration, shifted more smoothly than this car does.

the navigation software is another weak point. when driving in complicated road situations, it's not as intuitive or clear. it doesn't give enough early guidance for moving across several lanes on 6- or 8-lane city freeways, and it's not very clear about things like multi-lane exits where you need to pick a specific lane right after you exit. on top of that, the lane guidance is shown only in the hud, which feels like a bad design choice; those lane markers really should also show up on the main center display.

overall, the instrument screen behind the steering wheel is used poorly. both mercedes and audi handle that area much better, integrating it in a more sensible way with the center screen and hud, and audi especially is far ahead when it comes to how you can customize what's shown there.

the rear side window blinds are another disappointment, for two reasons. first, you have to go into the media screens to raise the shades, instead of them simply coming up automatically with a second press on the window raise hard button. second, the open channel where the side blinds sit looks unfinished. it comes across as unprofessional compared to what mercedes or audi do, where they have top covers hiding the blinds when they're stowed.

not being able to turn off auto start stop separately from the chosen drive mode is also annoying.

with the cruise control follow distance, there are two problems. you can't adjust the following gap while actually driving without digging through multiple menus, and even at the maximum setting the car follows too closely at moderate speeds. between about 45 and 60 mph, the farthest setting still feels uncomfortably, almost rudely, close to the car ahead.

the automatic lane keeping is behind the competition too. compared to audi and mercedes, it doesn't hold the lane as reliably or as smoothly, often failing to stay centered and tending to wander side to side. the lane keeping in this 760 really reminds me of mercedes' first generation system from something like 10 to 12 years ago.

Classifications:

- Difficult to Use (complaint): Lane departure warning : Response characteristics: too jerky/too abrupt / Lane departure warning / Response characteristics: too jerky/too abrupt

Customer comment:

> Customer stated the Lane Departure Warning sensor feels extremely aggressive, to the point that at times he needs both hands on the wheel to counteract it. Customer reported that whenever he turns on the indicator and attempts to change lanes, the system still pulls him back into the original lane. Writer explained that the Steering Intervention should not be engaging while the turn signal is on and asked whether he moves over right away after signaling or waits briefly. Customer replied he has tried changing lanes both immediately and after a delay, and said on several occasions the system has nearly led to an accident, which has frightened him. Customer commented that he does appreciate the warning itself because it helps when he might be distracted, and noted he never drives with Cruise Control. Writer advised that the Lane Departure Warning vibration in the steering wheel can be adjusted and the Steering Intervention can be switched off. Customer mentioned he was not by the vehicle and refused a follow up call. Writer walked him through where to locate the settings, and Customer said he was relieved it can be disabled since he had been thinking about switching to another vehicle.

Customer comment:

> Customer stated that 2 days ago while using Apple CarPlay, the display froze on Navigation. Customer stated the lockup affected both his phone and the iDrive. Customer stated he turned the vehicle off and back on, but the situation remained unchanged. Customer stated the problem cleared by itself after about 2 hours. Customer stated he uses Apple Maps and that nothing else was impacted. Writer verified the phone (iPhone 12 MINI) and carrier (Spectrum), and asked if the iOS version was current. Customer stated he typically waits a few days before installing iOS updates. Writer suggested updating to iOS 17.0.3 and advised powering the phone down and turning it back on. Writer stated that once the phone restarts, customer should un-pair it, remove it from iDrive, and then pair it again.

### G70-3276

- Source: Source B
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Difficult to Use
- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Difficult to Use (complaint): ConnectedDrive services (smartphone) technology overall : Not user-friendly / ConnectedDrive services (smartphone) technology overall / Not user-friendly

Customer comment:

> Customer reported that at random times the car speakers suddenly sound as if they are broken, with a crackling noise. Customer explained it will go on for around 30-40 minutes and then the sound returns to normal. Customer mentioned this happens when using CarPlay wirelessly, with CarPlay over USB, and also when only using Bluetooth. Customer described it as a high pitched squeal that makes music impossible to listen to, almost like the speakers are underwater. Customer stated the same thing happens on phone calls. Customer noted they have tried different iPhones: an iPhone 14 Pro, an iPhone Pro belonging to his wife, and a friend's iPhone 12. Customer added that the issue also affects the IPA. Customer said calls placed via the vehicle eSim are fine, and that Sirius XM and FM radio play with no problems. Customer reiterated that after about 30-40 minutes the sound is fine again, but it is so random that he has not been able to show it to the dealer. Writer asked if the phone is on the latest iOS, and customer confirmed it is not. Writer recommended updating to the current iOS, then fully powering the phone off and restarting it. Writer further advised un-pairing the phone, removing it from iDrive, and pairing again. Writer suggested rebooting iDrive by holding the radio power button for 30 seconds. Writer recommended a visit to the dealership and also suggested, when a passenger is present, attempting to capture a recording of the noise.

Customer comment:

> Customer stated that after bringing the vehicle home from delivery he got a notification about a software update. Customer stated he parked the car outside the garage and initiated the update. Customer stated that when he returned to the vehicle he was unable to get into it. Customer stated he contacted Roadside Assistance. Customer stated Roadside Assistance sent a tow truck, but that towing company could not move the car because it was not in neutral and there was no way to access the interior. Customer stated the local BMW arranged another style of tow truck and the vehicle was taken to the dealership. Customer stated the software update had completely frozen the car and it was totally dead. Customer stated the second towing company had to use dollies to tow it.
Customer stated the local dealer kept the car for 1 month. Customer stated that since getting it back, the vehicle has been fabulous.

DCS Notes: 
Defect Description: 
Head Unit High HU-H (Nav Professional) Software error / internal device fault

Complaint: 
Customer states they attempted to perform a remote update and the vehicle would not start after. Please check and advise

Cause: Complete discharge of battery/No communication to head unit/KOMBI. Confirmed customer complaint. Found vehicle completely dead, less than 2 volts measured at jump post for 12v battery. Attempted to jump start vehicle. Would not jump start. Connected VEHI. 

Correction: Removed passenger footwell trim to access BDC. Disconnected all connectors. Let rest for 15 minutes. Reconnected and reassembled vehicle. No change. Attempted to delete transport mode but was prohibited due to not enough voltage. Removed and installed new….

> i'm really unhappy with the self driving functions on this car. i paid more for this 7 series than for my previous one and ended up with fewer features. i believed it came with automatic traffic stop-and-go where it would handle heavy traffic on its own, and also with automatic lane change assist. right after picking up the car, i called the bmw genius for help, and after checking how the car was equipped they said those features should be there. they told me to go by a bmw dealership, so we stopped at one in riverside sc. the genius there said the car would need to stay at a dealer to be reprogrammed, but i couldn't leave it because i was only there briefly for business. i then booked service at a bmw store in bayport fl near our place in lakeside, and they held the car for 24 hours without a tech actually looking at it, then told me it was user error. during all of this i was waiting on a call from a bmw supervisor to sort things out. when i got back from fl, i left the car with my dealer in westfield ct, and after their troubleshooting they said the vehicle simply does not have those features and they can't be added. getting to that conclusion was extremely frustrating. in the end, it was my mistake for buying a car straight off the lot, not really knowing what equipment it had, and assuming i would end up with fewer features than the one i turned in.

Customer comment:

> Customer reports that their Wake Word function keeps shutting off. Customer noted that their daughter is a Genius at the dealership and they have already tried some troubleshooting together. Customer stated they completed a 30 second iDrive reboot. Writer accessed RVG and saw that the Wake Word activation slider was off, and when the customer attempted to switch it on, the slider turned green for a moment and then went back off. Customer was signed in with their BMW ID. Writer then performed a telecommunications reboot by holding the volume button for 70 seconds, allowing the iDrive display to power down three times, and afterward updated Apps and Services. Writer had the customer return to the Wake Word settings and the same problem persisted, with the feature still not able to be switched on. Writer apologized and recommended the customer schedule service. Customer agreed they would, but mentioned they are not sure when they will be able to go.

### G70-3487

- Source: Source B
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: PHEV
- Feedback types: Defect
- Signal types: complaint

Classifications:

- Defect (complaint): Cooling : Malfunction / Cooling / Malfunction

Customer comment:

> Customer stated he received an error message on the display and therefore had to bring the vehicle in for service. Customer stated the dealer informed him the problem was tied to an expansion valve. Per DCS: 
Claim Milesage: 527 
Defect Code:
 6450041200
Defect Description:
Expansion valve, high-voltage battery (hybrid) Permanently failed
Complaint:
CUSTOMER STATES THAT THE CHECK ENGINE LIGHT IS ON
Cause:
both valves *37 Ref TSARA# 3127280 WT .22 frus for checking and testing wires for power/ground/supply
Correction:
both w/in specs @ .2 ohms/fuse 62 shorted/Test both power source @valves 1&2/valves shorting internally/Performed HV voltage disconnect/Evacuated/recharged A/C system/Replaced both valves 1&2/cleared faults and test drove to verify repair.
 Technician Notes:

Customer comment:

> 1. it makes no sense not to have a sunglass holder. my old 740 had one, and in about three months with this car i've already broken two pricey pairs of sunglasses because of this bad design.
2. the app is moody and only seems to work when it feels like it, which is extremely irritating. i plug the car in, ride the garage elevator down, then the office tower elevator up, and the app tells me the car isn't charging. so i head back down the office building, up the garage elevator to the car, and it actually is charging. then i go back down the garage elevator, up the high rise again to my office, call bmw assist, and they say i have to return to the car to troubleshoot…meaning sitting in a hot garage while they poke around and doing the elevator shuffle twice more. forget it…click…that was me ending the call.
3. the air conditioning layout is very unfriendly to use.

the car itself drives well, but there are some things that are just not acceptable, especially the sunglasses issue you've been hearing about for years. if the next one shows up without a sunglass holder, my time at that dealer will be very short before i walk out. the charging quirks are a nuisance and waste my time, so i'll probably just end up guessing when it's actually done charging.

Customer comment:

> 2024 bmw 760i, to me, is a true mix of power and elegance. as a proud owner of the 2024 bmw 760i, it's hard not to be drawn in by how commanding it looks out on the road. the sleek exterior and the luxurious cabin make this flagship sedan feel like it radiates power and sophistication.

there's a real sense of empowerment that comes with driving something so prestigious. my wife, who is 5 foot 2 and around 100 pounds, is especially taken with the way the 760i carries itself. for her, it isn't just about the car's size, it's about feeling like she's in charge of the road and in control of a serious machine.

for her it goes beyond simple transportation; it's a statement, a way of showing her presence and capability. the 760i lives up to that, with strong performance from its potent engine and advanced tech features that give real confidence behind the wheel. whether we're weaving through city streets or cruising the highway, every trip feels like a small victory.

of course, people see a car like this differently. some might think it's about a "look-at-me" syndrome, wanting attention or validation. that may be true for some, but for many others a bmw 760i represents the result of hard work and success, a reward for what they've achieved and a symbol of personal accomplishment.

for me the 2024 bmw 760i is far more than just another vehicle; it stands for power, elegance and prestige. even if opinions about what it means vary, one thing is clear to me: it brings a huge amount of joy and satisfaction to anyone lucky enough to live with it every day.

Customer comment:

> this is my 4th brand-new 7 series and my 10th new bmw. pros: the engine is fantastic, a real beast; the tech is strong; and it drives very well overall.

cons: the hvac could cool better, likely because of the hidden vents, and it only got a bit better after i put clear uv tint on the windows. you also can't set sport mode as the default, even though i drive in sport most of the time. i can't remove the red and blue colors on the display and interactive bar, and i'm not a fan of those colors. the steering feels a little soft and not as connected to the road as my previous cars. it's a big car, and adding about 5" more length wasn't a good thing. the styling is just okay; i actually think my 2017 740i looks better.

Customer comment:

> the upgraded bowers wilkins stereo is awful and you should give money back to anyone who had to pay for it. in my earlier bmws with the b&w system it was great. you moved the speakers from under the seats and now it is laughable. everyone who rides in the car comments on the stereo and then i tell them it was a $4,800 upgrade... this might end up being my last bmw. when you turn it up there is basically no bass or mid at all. it sounds terrible, everything just disappears, really sad.
also, you cannot keep the ac on air recirculation or keep the whole climate system synced, it resets every single time you shut the car off. luxury should mean you do not have to keep doing things, but i have to spend about a minute every time i get in the car setting up stuff that should stay the same. ac fan level 2 is way too weak and 3 is too strong and loud. bring back proper air vents.
i am not happy with this purchase and this is my 8th 7 series in around 12 years. i will not renew to this again.

### G70-3735

- Source: Source A
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Defect, Difficult to Use, Wants, unknown_feedback_type
- Signal types: complaint, unknown, unmet_need

Classifications:

- Wants (unmet_need): Braking : Customer request: performance / Braking / Customer request: performance
- Defect (complaint): ConnectedDrive and Infotainment, overall technology : Malfunction / ConnectedDrive and Infotainment, overall technology / Malfunction
- Defect (complaint): Cushioning / damping vehicle : Malfunction / Cushioning / damping vehicle / Malfunction
- Difficult to Use (complaint): Door, open / close : Not user-friendly / Door, open / close / Not user-friendly
- Difficult to Use (complaint): Drivetrain : Drive power/driving performance not OK / Drivetrain / Drive power/driving performance not OK
- Difficult to Use (complaint): My Modes / driving experience : Not user-friendly / My Modes / driving experience / Not user-friendly
- Wants (unmet_need): Remote Software Upgrade/RSU : Customer request: function / Remote Software Upgrade/RSU / Customer request: function
- Wants (unmet_need): Space / spatial impression : Customer request: space / spatial impression / Space / spatial impression / Customer request: space / spatial impression
- unknown_feedback_type (unknown): no_class_found / no_class_found

Customer comment:

> the auto doors are cool, but they really need to react quicker in terms of the delay before they move, and be more consistent. this clearly needs a software update.

the auto driving sensors are not fully dependable, especially once the weather is anything less than ideal.

in auto cruise, the automatic braking when coming up on slower or stopped traffic is not trustworthy at all; if you just let it go, it will basically plow into the other car even though it clearly knows the car is there. that is ridiculous and needs fixing.

with navigation, the voice will sometimes ask something like, "is this the final destination or an intermediate destination?" and when you answer with "intermediate destination" or something almost word-for-word from what it asked, it replies "i don't know what that means." that is obviously dumb.

auto park is too complicated just to have it locate and park in a simple spot, and yes, i do understand how to use it.

sport mode offers too few speedometer display choices.

ar guidance showing where to turn should have a green arrow on the road surface.

the way auto cruise decides how much to slow for corners is all over the place. it over-slows some bends and attacks others like an f1 car.

major problem: auto speed control won't reduce speed until after the posted limit changes and you press the set button. clearly the car should be able to adjust speed ahead of the sign, so there must be an option to anticipate upcoming lower limits.

i also need clearer visual feedback that the air suspension has raised the car and that i'm actually driving with it raised.

overall i'm pretty satisfied with it. i'd be happy to send more comments by email. i have several high-end vehicles, and this is my second 740.

### G70-3757

- Source: Source A
- Vehicle: G70
- Market: US
- Engine type: ICE
- Feedback types: Defect, Likes, unknown_feedback_type
- Signal types: complaint, praise, unknown

Classifications:

- Defect (complaint): Dynamic Stability Control : Malfunction / Dynamic Stability Control / Malfunction
- Likes (praise): Exterior design : Look / design appeals / Exterior design / Look / design appeals
- Defect (complaint): High voltage battery : Malfunction / High voltage battery / Malfunction
- Defect (complaint): Vehicle battery : Malfunction / Vehicle battery / Malfunction
- unknown_feedback_type (unknown): no_class_found / no_class_found

Customer comment:

> even though i really love the car itself, my first experiences with it have made me nervous about what owning it long-term will be like. the very first thing that went wrong was a dead 48 volt battery right at vehicle pickup, which meant i couldn't even drive my new $150,000 car home. i ended up waiting about a week while they sourced and installed a new battery.

then at just under 3,000 miles the dcs module failed, which made the brakes almost useless and nearly caused me to be part of a several-car pileup on a local freeway. this happened on december 23rd, during a drive from palm desert to pasadena (roughly 130 miles), and that made it even harder to get a tow truck out to me since i was about 88 miles from home. the wait for the tow was something like 3+ hours.

i've now been in a dealership loaner for over 10 days because the part my car needed was discontinued and replaced by a newer version that still isn't available. i will say bmw emergency service and my service advisors have been responsive, understanding, and sympathetic.

this is my 9th bmw, so i'm familiar with the quirks and issues they tend to develop as they get older, but seeing big problems like this on a brand-new vehicle feels pretty disheartening and discouraging. i waited a long time to be able to buy what i thought was the pinnacle of the bmw lineup, and now that i finally did, i feel somewhat let down.

that said, i truly love the look, the feel, and the way this thing drives; it has met or even exceeded what i expected from a flagship bmw. i'm hopeful that as we go forward my trust in bmw and its craftsmanship will come back. thank you for letting me share all of this.

- Difficult to Use (complaint): Wallbox, charging / home charging : Not user-friendly / Wallbox, charging / home charging / Not user-friendly

Customer comment:

> Customer stated one of the reasons he chose the i7 was the promotion that included a free BMW Wallbox along with a $2000 credit through Qmerit. Customer stated it has now been almost 2 months since he bought the vehicle and he still has no clear timing for when the BMW Wallbox will actually be installed. Customer stated Qmerit took roughly a month just to return his initial call. Customer stated Qmerit first tried to arrange an electrician based in Tampa, Florida, while he lives in Brookside, Florida, which is about 4 hours from Tampa. Customer stated Qmerit then scheduled a different electrician located in Laketon, Florida, roughly an hour and 20 minutes away from his home. Customer stated both of those electricians wanted to add extra charges because of the additional travel distance required. Customer stated they now finally have an electrician from Fairview, and Brookside is a suburb of Fairview, but the electrician advised it will be at least 3 more months before they can come out to install the Wallbox. 
Customer stated Qmerit is not living up to the expectations he has for a company associated with BMW. 
Customer asked to have his case escalated so BMW can look into a solution with Qmerit that might get his installation moved up, as he does not want to wait 6 months from the purchase date to have the Wallbox installed at his home.
